description: The duplicated-word typo 'TTL greater than than the maximum' appears verbatim on three separate couchbase-cli reference pages describing the max-TTL option: couchbase-cli-bucket-create.md, couchbase-cli-bucket-edit.md, and couchbase-cli-collection-manage.md (confirmed by direct grep of all three). Direct evidence of the same explanatory sentence being copy-pasted across at least three command pages rather than independently authored, consistent with this round's broader authorship-provenance finding about cli/.
